sourceStatement: THIS CONTRACT IS DERIVED FROM REFERENCE DOCUMENTATION, NOT FROM A PUBLISHED SPECIFICATION. VCF Automation has no specification in the vmware/vcf-api-specs repository (Apache-2.0); no machine-readable OpenAPI document is published for it. Every operation, parameter, field and status code below was transcribed by hand from the rendered VCF Automation xAPIs reference pages on developer.broadcom.com. Each page URL, the operation it documents and the date it was fetched are recorded in docs/official_sources.json. Because the source is prose reference documentation rather than a normative schema artifact, this contract is the project's own restatement of the API: where the reference pages are silent (for example on wire-level serialization of unset optional fields) this file states the project's binding decision explicitly and marks it as such.

api.title: VCF Automation API
api.lineage: successor to vRealize Automation / VMware Aria Automation

operations.summary: Returns the complete list of available actions that can be performed on a given deployment.
Submits a day-2 action request against a deployment. This is the only mutating call in this contract.

properties.name: actionType
properties.description: Resource action type. Possible values are : RESOURCE_ACTION, RESOURCE_EXTENSION,

properties.name: formDefinition
properties.description: Resource action custom UI definition; fields formURI (string) and trackProgressInModal (boolean)

properties.name: schema
properties.description: Schema describing a policy object of this type

properties.name: valid
properties.description: Resource action is valid for current state

properties.name: actionId
properties.description: The id of the action to perform.

gating.statement: submitDeploymentActionRequest MUST NOT be sent unless getDeploymentActions has first been sent for the same deploymentId and has returned an action that both matches the requested action name and carries valid == true. The reference documentation defines ResourceAction.valid as 'Resource action is valid for current state', so an action that is listed but not valid is not eligible for submission.

gateConditions.when: No entry in the getDeploymentActions response has name equal to the requested action name.
A matching entry exists but its valid field is not exactly boolean true.

gating.onGate: No mutating request is issued. Nothing on the appliance is changed. The caller is told which gate condition fired.
gating.onPrecheckError: If getDeploymentActions returns a non-2xx status the precheck has not succeeded, so no mutating request is issued; the error is surfaced to the caller.

serialization.statement: PROJECT DECISION, not a quotation from the reference pages. The reference documentation marks actionId, inputs and reason as optional but does not say how an unset optional field must appear on the wire. This project binds that choice: an unset optional field is OMITTED FROM THE JSON OBJECT ENTIRELY. It is never sent as an empty string, an empty object, an empty array or a JSON null. A reason that is null, empty or entirely whitespace counts as unset. An inputs map that is null or empty counts as unset.

rules.sendWhen: always, set to the id of the validated action
only when the caller supplied a reason with at least one non-whitespace character
rules.omitAs: key absent from the JSON object

rules.sendWhen: only when the caller supplied a non-empty inputs map
rules.omitAs: key absent from the JSON object

outOfScope.statement: The VM Apps Org - Deployment API publishes many more operations than this contract names. The operations listed here are the only ones this project speaks. Anything else is a contract violation, and the loopback mock refuses it.
